keyFindings.description: The writer keeps two memos of 'no closer from here', and the new one is never read on the writer's path. opensAt returns false at :298-299 (ends[kind] == htmlEndNone) before it reaches rawHTMLParser.Parse, and it sets htmlEndNone at :311 whenever the parser returns nil. That parser call is also the only one that writes declarationBlock.unclosed. So the record the writer's context holds is written and never read. The pc field (:274) and its allocation per scan (:329) serve only that unread write, and the two sentinel conventions (htmlEndUnasked/htmlEndNone against htmlUnclosedUnwalked) need two comments to tell apart. Fix: make one memo answer. Either the writer keeps only found ends and lets the record refuse in O(1), or the parser skips the record when it is given no context.

The names and the file no longer match what the code owns. declarationParser is now the package's inline raw HTML parser for every kind. declarationBlock, declarationBlockKey and declarationBlockOf record comment, PI and CDATA closers too, and they share a prefix with declarationBlockParser, the unrelated block parser in the same file. The reader also switches on rawHTMLCloser and the htmlComment..htmlCloserKinds constants, which still live in the writer's render_inline.go. Fix: rename the parser and its record for what they cover, and move rawHTMLCloser and the kind constants beside opensDeclaration. Also write the record once at the end of Parse rather than in two places with two copies of the soundness comment (move the declaration walk into its own function).

The same timing tables appear in this file (:45-64) and in linear_test.go (:330-350), and they contradict each other on walk counts: 'walked once where it was walked three times' against 'once rather than twice'. Both say 'this pull request's fork point'. Keep the numbers in the test comment alone, and state the invariant in the type's doc.

The list of the rule's callers at :18-21 is wrong now: declarationParser asks rawHTMLCloser, which asks opensDeclaration. packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:2080 says the same thing. AGENTS.md also states no per-block guarantee for unclosed raw HTML that a new kind must keep.
:308 'The raw HTML parser reads no parent' is false: the record is keyed by parent. The scan's nil parent keys its one block.
:16-17 'so a `<` is read by one parser' is not true: goldmark's autolink parser at 300 also triggers on `<`. The claim holds for raw HTML.
